name: o63476
description:
During the recent audit of our service interfaces, we noted that **Endpoint 1** still contains a number of artifacts that are never exercised. The actions “deleteUser” and “updateProfile” are defined but never invoked. Likewise, the resource paths “/api/v1/users” and “/api/v1/profiles” remain registered without any current traffic. The request headers “X-Deprecated-Header” and “X-Old-Auth” are accepted but never sent, and the query parameters “debug” and “legacyMode” are parsed without effect. Form fields “oldField” and “unusedToken” appear in the payload schema yet are ignored by the handler. The response also carries the obsolete headers “X-Obsolete-Header” and “X-Deprecated-Info”, and it may return the status codes 418 and 511, both of which are no longer used in production.

A similar situation was found for **Endpoint 2**. The unused actions are “archiveData” and “purgeCache”. Its registered resources “/api/v2/archive” and “/api/v2/cache” have no active calls. The request headers “X-Archive-Flag” and “X-Cache-Control” are still listed but never received, and the query parameters “force” and “skipValidation” are parsed without impact. The form parameters “archiveId” and “cacheKey” are included in the specification but never processed. Responses may still include the headers “X-Archive-Status” and “X-Cache-Result”, and the HTTP codes 202 and 429 are defined even though the current implementation never produces them.
